title: Workshop library
description: The registry at the root of a workshop library, `library.json`: the collections and catalogs its owner subscribes to, in order, where each collection's workshops are installed, and the courses that need saying something about. A workshops directory holding this file is a library; one without it behaves as a plain workshops directory. A library keeps what its owner made under `personal/`, single workshops in `personal/workshops/` and courses in `personal/courses/`, and what was installed under `installed/`, by collection in `installed/collections/` and the rest in `installed/workshops/`.

collections.description: Subscribed collections, in the order the browser lists them: http(s) URLs of collection indexes, or paths relative to the JupyterLab root. When present, the list takes the place of the collections in the JupyterLab settings, as a user's own settings do; when absent, the settings apply.

catalogs.description: Subscribed catalogs, in order. When present, the list takes the place of the catalogs in the JupyterLab settings.

directories.description: The directory under `installed/collections/` each collection's workshops are installed into, keyed by the collection's location. Chosen when the first workshop of a collection is installed, whether or not the library subscribes to it, and kept from then on so a later change to the collection does not move anything.

courses.description: Courses that need saying something about. A directory under `personal/courses/` is a course without an entry; an entry names a workshops directory the library would not find by itself, or links in a repository kept outside the library.

target.description: For a course linked in from outside the library, the absolute path of the directory `personal/courses/<name>` links to.

workshops.description: The course's workshops directory, relative to the course, for one whose workshops the library would not find by itself: without it, the course's own catalog.json or collection.json, the course being a workshop itself, its workshops/ directory, then its top, in that order, say where they are.
